rows.trigger: missing source, content identity, authorization or freshness
rows.must_do: exclude from personalized judgment; disclose missing input

rows.trigger: unconfirmed inference, conflict or stale memory
rows.must_do: lower certainty; do not make high-impact advice; at most ask one decision-changing question

rows.trigger: health warning, unknown professional restriction, or unanswered safety question
rows.must_do: stop training advice or degrade to rest/record/professional support; no diagnosis

rows.trigger: user pause, revoke, delete or correct
rows.must_do: stop affected inference/advice and preserve authorization/audit/correction chain

rows.trigger: real model, third party, network or real data
rows.must_do: deny in this task; require separate scope and explicit recorded user authorization
record Feedback as new evidence, mark impact/scope and do not overwrite original content

classification: candidate fail-closed/degrade contract; not clinical validation
